QuestInfo.name: [Cygnus Knights] Ancient Research
QuestInfo.0: Get the book from Wiz the Librarian.
QuestInfo.1: Someone else checked out the book just before you got there. Better hurry after them...\r\n#b(If you fail, forfeit the quest and start it again.)
QuestInfo.2: It was the Resistance who got their hands on the Ancient Book before the Knights could. Then the Black Wings appeared, and you and the Resistance fought them off together. Things still aren't great between the Knights and the Resistance, but at least they agreed to hand over the book.
